composition_label: Structured extraction -> Knowledge-base answers -> Sentiment & prioritization -> Product comparison

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory using synthetic fixtures

request.fixture_label: Nonempty fixture identification; example explicitly labeled SYNTHETIC
request.document: String; empty document is accepted and produces missing-field reports
request.fields: Nonempty array of unique {name, pattern, type, required}; type is string, integer or number; required is boolean
request.question_field: Name of a declared string field
request.knowledge_base: Array of unique {id, question, answer} with nonempty strings
request.products: Array of unique {id, name, attributes}; attributes optionally include price, battery, warranty, each as {value, unit}
request.preferences: Nonempty array of unique {attribute, direction, weight}; direction min/max, finite weight in (0, 100]

envelope.stage: input, extract, faq, sentiment or compare
envelope.data: Cumulative stage objects in execution order; no unrelated keys

shared_schema.errors: {schema_version: 1.0, status: error, error: message}; stdout JSON and exit 2
shared_schema.validation_layer: validate() checks the common envelope and validate_request() checks the common request. Each stage validates its predecessor and its own result. Extraction source spans/value conversions, missing reports, FAQ answer/citation grounding, exact sentiment derivation and exact comparison derivation are validated.
shared_schema.source_spans: Zero-based, half-open Python Unicode character offsets into the original document, adjusted to exclude surrounding whitespace
shared_schema.numeric_policy: Reject boolean-as-number, NaN, infinity, negative attributes, unsupported units, duplicate identifiers and duplicate JSON object keys

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated question_field value with retained source span and document provenance
cross_stage_handoffs.missing_behavior: A missing or non-informative question explicitly abstains; optional and required missing fields remain visible

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated FAQ query and answered/abstained status
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Score only customer query, never the KB response; abstention adds 10 priority points

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated issue priority, severity and propagated FAQ status
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Priority >=70 adds a max-warranty preference with weight 2 or boosts an existing max-warranty weight by 2. Explicit minimize-warranty preference is preserved.

behavior.extraction: First regex match per schema field; named group value if available, otherwise full match. Trim matched text while preserving exact offsets. Failed type conversions are reported as invalid and missing, not silently fabricated.
behavior.retrieval: Case-folded ASCII alphanumeric token sets with explicit stopwords; score is query-token coverage by article question. Highest score meeting threshold wins; equal scores resolve by article id. Answer is the complete verbatim KB answer and its article id, otherwise answer/citation are null with an abstention reason.
behavior.sentiment: Transparent fixed lexicon with per-occurrence token index, score and immediate preceding not/never/no negation. Sum determines positive/neutral/negative. Critical severity terms outrank high terms independently of sentiment.
behavior.priority: Base critical=100, high=70, normal=30; negative sentiment adds 10; unanswered adds 10; cap at 100. Reasons are explicit.
behavior.normalization: Price USD/cents -> USD; battery hours/minutes -> hours; warranty months/years -> months; units are case insensitive and normalized values must remain finite.
behavior.comparison: Side-by-side rows include null for missing attributes. Per-attribute min-max utility honors preference direction; equal observed values receive utility 1 and missing values receive 0. Weighted mean scores are rounded to six decimals; ties resolve by product id. All contributions, effective weights and severity-related adjustments are returned.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clocks, networks, providers or external state in the implementation; caller input is deep-copied

included: One integrated CLI and one validated pipeline
Schema-driven extraction with missing and invalid field reports
Grounded verbatim FAQ answers and explicit abstention
Three normalized numeric product attributes and preference ranking
Synthetic fixture, unit tests, cross-stage integrity tests and subprocess CLI tests
JSON file, syntax, encoding and validation error handling
excluded: Live or injected LLM calls; none are needed for the deterministic reference
Network services, enterprise deployment, authentication and persistence
Semantic retrieval, embeddings and probabilistic confidence calibration
General natural-language extraction or multilingual sentiment; lexicon tokenization is ASCII English
Safety certification or assurance from product rankings; warranty is only a demonstration preference
Regex execution sandboxing or timeout protection; schema patterns are trusted configuration
Advanced negation, sarcasm, coreference and contextual severity interpretation; severity triggers conservatively remain active even when negated

coverage: All four stages and their ordered handoffs
Exact and Unicode source spans, trimming, named and full-match captures
Integer conversion, missing required/optional fields and conversion failures
Grounding, relevance threshold, abstention, empty KB and deterministic retrieval ties
Sentiment contributions, negation, positive sentiment with critical severity, answer-text isolation
Unanswered priority propagation and severity-dependent ranking changes
Unit conversion, missing attributes, equal products and empty catalog
Invalid schemas, regexes, units, values, identities and preferences
Rejected wrong-stage, tampered-span, unsupported-answer and tampered-sentiment handoffs
CLI success, usage error, missing file, malformed JSON, non-finite JSON and duplicate JSON keys
